transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, honestly, the thing that really scared me into coming in is... my eating has just been all over the place lately. Like, some days I'll just completely forget about meals altogether. And then other nights, I'm just tearing through takeout and a bunch of snacks way past midnight. It's just been really weird.
After eating like that late at night, do you do anything to try to make up for the food you ate, such as making yourself throw up or taking laxatives?
No, I don't do anything like that. I don't throw up or use laxatives or anything. I just... I just eat a lot and then feel kind of bad about it, but I don't try to undo it or whatever.
Aside from your eating habits, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless lately?
No, not really. I mean, I'm a little stressed about the eating stuff, but I wouldn't say I feel depressed or hopeless. My mood's actually been... pretty okay, mostly.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on tasks or find yourself getting easily distracted?

Yeah, actually. It's been pretty bad at work lately. I'll be in the middle of entering a wholesale order, and... I don't know, my phone will buzz, or I'll hear a truck pulling up outside, or just someone walking past the office. And it just completely pulls me off track. It's like I can't filter it out. I get so distracted that I end up missing basic details on the orders that I would normally catch without a problem.
Did you experience similar difficulties with attention or focus when you were a child, before the age of twelve?
No, not really. I mean, I did fine in school when I was a kid. I don't remember having any problems paying attention back then. It's just been a more recent thing.
Does this eating happen after you've already fallen asleep and wake up during the night, or while you're still awake before going to bed?

Um, no, I don't wake up in the middle of the night to eat. It's just while I'm still awake, before I go to bed. I haven't ever really fallen asleep and then woken back up to do it or anything like that.
During those times when you are eating late at night, do you feel a sense of loss of control, like you cannot stop eating or control what or how much you are eating?
No, I wouldn't say I feel out of control. It's just... I get hungry, so I eat. I don't feel like I can't stop or anything. I just eat until I'm full and then I go to sleep.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with an atypical eating pattern characterized by skipping daytime meals followed by substantial late-night eating before sleep, causing concern and distress. Bulimia nervosa and binge eating disorder are ruled out due to the absence of compensatory behaviors and lack of a perceived loss of control during eating episodes. Adult ADHD is also excluded due to the absence of childhood onset prior to age 12. The presentation is best classified as an other specified eating disorder/night eating syndrome under F50.8.
